description: This YAML file defines a class-like data structure representing a WFA Map TLV for Steering BTM Report, including type definitions, enumerations, and conditional fields relevant to BSS/STA MAC addresses and status codes.

classes.name: tlvSteeringBTMReport
classes.description: Represents the BTM Steering Report TLV with fields such as type, length, BSSID, STA MAC, status code, and conditionally included target BSSID.

classes.name: eBTMStatusCode
classes.description: Enumeration of possible BTM status codes indicating acceptance or various rejection reasons.
